name: FFF
description: Searches files and code fast for coding agents through a local MCP server with typo-tolerant grep, file finding, and frecency ranking, plus Node and Python SDKs.

skills.name: Grep Code
skills.description: Searches file contents in smart-case, regex, or literal mode with path and glob filters, retrying as fuzzy when nothing matches.

skills.name: Find Files
skills.description: Finds files by path fragment or approximate filename, ranked by frecency so the files you open most come first.

skills.name: Multi-Pattern Grep
skills.description: Searches for several literal patterns at once across the indexed project in a single multi_grep tool call.

skills.name: Find Definitions
skills.description: Finds declarations first with definitions_only, then exact references and fuzzy matches, labeling each fallback.

skills.name: Git-Aware Results
skills.description: Tags modified, untracked, and staged files in results so agents reach for the code you are actively changing.
